##### Project general facts

Trump Executive Residences and Trump Park Residences form parts of Trump Plaza Jeddah a development by DarGlobal. Trump Park Residences offering is a limited collection of townhouses and apartments, positioned as a private residential enclave distinct from Trump Plaza's commercial core. Residence formats include three and four-bedroom townhouses and two, three and four-bedroom apartments, designed for residents seeking privacy, scale and an elevated urban address. Trump Executive Residences offering comprises one, two and three-bedroom apartments designed for professionals seeking a business-focused residential address. The architecture follows a contemporary glass-and-steel style, reflecting Trump Plaza's composed, understated aesthetic.

Residents have access to the members-only Vitality Club, a two-level wellness and performance destination featuring three swimming pools set to different temperatures, a spa with separate male and female sections offering a tranquility lounge, barber shop and salon, and a recovery suite with sauna, hammam, salt room and steam facilities. The club also includes a performance space for gym, cycling, pilates, yoga and reformer classes, sports medicine and physiotherapy services, two golf simulator rooms with a pro shop, personal coaching, day care, and lockers and changing rooms. Additional lifestyle spaces include a cigar and library lounge, a coffee lounge, and members' lounges and meeting rooms. Trump Plaza further offers Grade-A offices, retail and dining outlets including an all-day dining restaurant, an artisan bakery and a specialty grocery, alongside a private landscaped park spanning the area of a football pitch.

Interiors at Trump Executive Residences are hotel-finished, delivered move-in ready with premium Trump finishes and curated furniture. A range of à la carte services is available on an optional basis, and owners may opt into a dedicated management package covering leasing and day-to-day operation of their residence. The residences are fully furnished, with furniture, kitchen and appliances included. Interiors at Trump Park Residences feature signature Trump detailing, with materials and finishes selected for permanence and precision, alongside expansive layouts and terraces. The residences are delivered unfurnished, in accordance with the specifications stated in the sale agreement.

##### Location description and benefits 

Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia’s most vibrant coastal cities, located along the Red Sea and known as the country’s main gateway for trade and travel. As a major urban hub, it combines a rich historical heritage with modern infrastructure, offering a dynamic lifestyle shaped by its role as a commercial center and its proximity to the holy cities of Mecca and Medina. The city continues to expand with large-scale developments, making it an important destination for both living and investment.

The architecture of Jeddah reflects a unique blend of old and new. The historic district of Al-Balad features traditional coral-stone buildings with intricate wooden balconies, while the rest of the city is defined by contemporary towers, waterfront developments, and master-planned communities. The iconic Jeddah Corniche stretches along the coastline, offering scenic views, public beaches, and landscaped leisure areas that enhance the city’s appeal.

Jeddah provides a well-rounded lifestyle with a wide range of amenities, including international schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, and fine dining options. Residents enjoy access to waterfront promenades, marinas, and recreational spaces, while ongoing projects and infrastructure improvements continue to elevate the quality of living. With its strategic location, cultural depth, and continuous growth, Jeddah stands out as a key residential and investment destination in Saudi Arabia.
